title: Doggone Matchmas: A Four Dogs Holiday Singles Social
shortDescription: A relaxed holiday singles social with conversation starters, a Four Dogs game, and new connections.
description: Single this holiday season? Join Four Dogs at Charter 803 for a relaxed evening of meeting people, sharing a few laughs, and making connections. The night begins with casual speed dating and conversation cards, followed by an interactive Four Dogs game. Friends may also take the mic for a Doggone Good Catch Spotlight. No pressure or promises, just a fun reason to get out and meet someone new.
